# proxmox_guest_rrd_image (Data Source)

Reads a guest RRD graph as PNG data from `GET /nodes/{node}/{type}/{vmid}/rrd`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_guest_rrd_image" "cpu" {
  type = "qemu"
  node = "pve"
  vmid = 100
  ds   = "cpu"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ds` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Optional

- `cf` (String)
- `timeframe` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `image` (String)
